name: AICardDataTable
description: AICardDataTable is the canonical pattern for AI-generated tables across Guild. It supersedes ad-hoc table compositions inside chat bubbles, side drawers, dashboard modules, and review flows.
intent: One reusable table block — compact in chat, contextual in a drawer, governed in a review flow. Density picks how much trust + action context comes along.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.
